page_title: PAU 2-1 WER | St. Pauli v Werder Bremen 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Soren Storks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
90+2' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+1' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' A yellow card for a tackle by Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen). Soren Storks doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) for Joel Fujita.
84' The linesman raises his flag. Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.

83' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
83' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) commits a rough foul. Soren Storks stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to St. Pauli.
80' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Jackson Irvine and he is replaced by James Sands (St. Pauli).
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) coming on for Cameron Puertas.
76' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card.
75' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Soren Storks didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
75' The attendance is 29546.
75' A yellow-coloured card is received by Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli).
74' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
74' Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
73' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
70' 2 - 1 Goal! Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) takes a short pass from Manolis Saliakas in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
69' It looks like Karol Mets (St. Pauli) saw red with that tackle. Soren Storks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Werder Bremen have been awarded a free kick.

68' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
67' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
66' Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to St. Pauli.
66' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
62' 1 - 1 Goal! Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
62' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
61' Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch for Marco Grull.
60' Daniel Thioune has decided to make a change. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) replaces Romano Schmid.
60' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mio Backhaus intercepts the ball.

55' 1 - 0 Danel Sinani showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 1:0.
55' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
54' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Soren Storks ignores the protests.
53' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) replaces Martijn Kaars.
53' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
48' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. St. Pauli are awarded a free kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
41' Soren Storks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) and blew his whistle. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
40' The free kick is taken by Eric Smith (St. Pauli), but ball is cleared.
40' A player from Werder Bremen takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. St. Pauli are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
37' Flag up against Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
35' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
33' Half-chance! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) plays a pass into the box, but Nikola Vasilj reacts well to snuff out the attack.

32' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
32' The resulting free kick from Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
31' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Soren Storks saw the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Werder Bremen.
30' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
30' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Today's referee Soren Storks rightly decides to book Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) for his harsh tackle.
29' It's a nice effort by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Nikola Vasilj. Easy save.
26' A pass by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.

26' The cross into the penalty area from Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
25' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
23' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
21' A cross into the box from Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) is cleared.
19' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
18' Werder Bremen are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
15' Rough tackle by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to St. Pauli.
12' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. St. Pauli will take a free kick near the side line.
10' Half-chance! Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) plays a pass into the box, but Mio Backhaus reacts well to snuff out the attack.
8' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) is caught offside!
8' It seemed like Eric Smith (St. Pauli) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
7' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
6' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
5' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
5' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but it's cleared. Now Werder Bremen have a corner.

4' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
2' Dangerous play by Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen). Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. St. Pauli have a free kick.
2' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
